Applied the four admission criteria AND the required economical-boundary precondition. Public byte/state/helper APIs can be integration boundaries without executing a full CLI or real provider.

A move preserves existing behavior/cases at a public boundary in a follow-up; no new test behavior is authorized. A retirement consolidates redundant controls where warranted, deletes policy/wiring/getter/benchmark cases, or removes a stale allowance.
Required isolated child entry points are judged with the parent harness; a no-op outer invocation is not mistaken for a standalone behavioral test.
The 943 identities in the original brief and 949 at task-pilot were historical. This pinned baseline contains 975 identities, of which 968 still have a source function.

Every non-keep entry has a per-crate spawned_from follow-up. Retained private seams/support must survive removal and relocation. Follow-up implementers recheck source drift and duplicate boundary coverage before touching the pinned identity.
